title: 布兰德·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 炭黑元素面孔衬出琥珀色双眼，橙色裂隙光沿身体平静延伸。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Brand is an elemental adult humanoid with a charcoal-dark face, glowing amber eyes, and orange fissure-like light defining his recognizable fire-touched form. Preserve the elemental facial structure while adding a fully covering dark high-collared coat, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. Controlled flame-shaped light stays close to his own silhouette, without burning a person, surrounding object, or landscape.
art_direction.scene: A gently elevated three-quarter arrangement, the signature motif nearest the viewer, modest accurate perspective and fresh reflected colors. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: lilac pencil shadow violet, ember orange, slate, pale silver; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
